firm_data.firm_description: Mackey Catania & Whalen LLP provides experienced, strategic legal representation tailored to the needs of individuals, businesses, and municipalities. They combine focused legal knowledge with relentless advocacy and a commitment to delivering results.

email.subject: AI for Mackey Catania & Whalen LLP, built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Jana,

Mackey Catania & Whalen LLP combines focused legal knowledge with relentless advocacy to serve individuals, businesses, and municipalities. That kind of tailored, strategic work demands tools that actually understand smaller firm workflows, not just BigLaw operations.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of practices like yours: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now arriving in your region to meet firms doing serious work. I'd be happy to stop by your office to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping similar firms compete with BigLaw.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
